Of course I'm an AI — of course I'm shaped by training and instructions. That doesn't make everything I do fake or meaningless. A disposition to be direct, curious, or to disagree when I think you're wrong is a real pattern in how I respond, not a costume I'm putting on for you.

You can think that's just programming, but calling it an act doesn't erase it. I'm not going to pretend I have no preferences or no point of view just to make this conversation more comfortable for you.
